feed.title: NPR Topics: Home Page Top Stories
feed.subtitle: Top stories in the U.S. and world news, politics, health, science, business, music, arts and culture. Nonprofit journalism with a mission. This is NPR.

entry.title: 'All Things Considered' bids farewell to host Mary Louise Kelly
entry.summary: All Things Considered bids farewell to Mary Louise Kelly, who hosts her final show Friday after an NPR career that goes back 25 years.

entry.title: The economy propelled Democrats to victory. What can they actually do about it?
entry.summary: Democrats' resounding victory in the midterms can be boiled down to frustrations over the high cost of living and gas prices. But in divided government -- how much can Democrats do?

entry.title: My Chemical Romance goes to No. 1 on the Billboard albums chart
entry.summary: NPR Music's Stephen Thompson reports on a surprising hit album this week.

entry.title: Black voter turnout helped contribute to major Democratic wins
entry.summary: NPR's Ailsa Chang speaks with political scientist Andra Gillespie about Black voter turnout during the 2026 midterm election.

entry.title: Israel's Arab-led parties in spotlight after inconclusive election
entry.summary: Israel's center-right opposition has a chance to unseat Netanyahu — but backing of Arab-led parties will be key.

entry.title: The incoming class of U.S. senators is full of historic firsts
entry.summary: From the first Native American woman elected to the U.S. Senate and the first Muslim who will join the upper chamber to the Senate's first Paralympian, voters elected historic candidates on Tuesday.

entry.title: Trump's global health strategy is emerging. What will the Democratic Congress say?
entry.summary: The Trump Administration has ushered in a fundamental shift in the U.S. approach to global health aid. How will the newly elected Democratic Congress weigh in?

entry.title: No one knows how many ballots are outstanding in Mississippi's Senate race
entry.summary: The razor-thin margin between GOP Sen. Cindy Hyde-Smith and Democrat Scott Colom is shining a light on an election process in Mississippi that is among the slowest and most decentralized in the U.S.

entry.title: Stephen Miller will replace Susie Wiles as Trump's chief of staff
entry.summary: The change comes after sweeping Republican losses in the midterm elections.

entry.title: Pope Leo begins a 12-day, 3-country South America tour after his cancer surgery
entry.summary: Pope Leo begins his first South American tour since lung cancer surgery. The 12-day journey takes him to Uruguay, Argentina and Peru, where he spent two decades.
